5-Minute Blender Hummus

Canned chickpeas, one blender, five minutes. No tahini required.

Prep
5 min prep
Total / resting
5 min total
Ingredients & Method ↓

Development edition · Awaits kitchen testing.

Ingredients Method Storage

Ingredients

How many people?
4

Estimated to serve 4 people as a dip or spread (about 1.5 cups total).

  • 1 can chickpeas, drained
    Package size: 15 oz / 425 g.
  • 2 tbsp olive oil
  • 1 garlic clove
  • Juice of ½ lemon
  • ¼ cup water (adjust to texture)
  • Salt to taste

None standard. Check all ingredient labels.

Advertisement

Method

01

Blend until smooth.

Blend everything until nearly smooth, adding water gradually until you reach the texture you want.

02

Taste and adjust.

Taste and adjust salt or lemon before serving.

Look for: Perfectly smooth, creamy, and lighter in color.

Why it works: Using just a few everyday ingredients and adjusting the water creates a creamy texture without tahini.

Serve with

Serve with fresh vegetables or warm pita bread.

One way to change it up

Add 1 tbsp tahini if you have it — this version skips it on purpose to keep the ingredient list short.

A small technique note

Add the water gradually to control how thick or loose the hummus gets.

Storage & Prep ahead

This recipe awaits kitchen testing. A refrigerated shelf life has not yet been established.
